description: Conformance manifest for the W2-G organizational-hierarchy + external-authority-boundary example fixtures (ACCEPTED FOR IMPLEMENTATION — v0.1.0, not stable v1/GA). 'kind' drives the expected validation outcome: positive = MUST validate; negative-schema = MUST fail JSON Schema validation; negative-semantic = MUST validate structurally but MUST be rejected by a relying-party invariant a schema alone cannot enforce (a fixed test clock NOW=1899635200 = 2030-03-13T12:26:40Z makes the time/relationship/downgrade checks deterministic; a schema cannot compare two field values, walk a tree for descendant/sibling/cycle, evaluate wall-clock expiry/revocation, or compare a marking against its source). Schema paths are relative to contracts/json-schema/; fixture paths are relative to contracts/examples/org/. Maps to ADR-0007 contract delta D-1..D-8 and invariants INV-1/INV-2 + FC-1..FC-10.

examples.note: D-1 tier-0 deployment root: parent_id null, internal.
D-1 tier-1 node with locale-catalog label key + vi/en fallback (no hard-coded administrative string).
D-1 tier-2 node — tier is an ordinal into a configured ladder.
D-1 tier-3 leaf with jurisdiction policy-as-data — a 4-tier (0..3) configurable tree, no fixed tier names.
INV-2 external (A05) peer: boundary_kind external, parent_id null, separate tenant_binding — an exchange peer, never in the internal ladder.
D-2 analyst membership at a leaf node; confers_descendant_raw false (membership never confers raw descendant access).
D-2 tier-coordinator membership at a governance tier; still confers_descendant_raw false.
D-4 own-node raw: subject reads their OWN node's raw records within tenant + need-to-know.
D-4 explicit descendant-read grant (non-empty raw_scope + need-to-know + SoD): the ONLY way ancestry reaches raw descendant data (INV-1).
D-4 ancestor-governance aggregate (k=5): the default cross-tier reach — de-identified, no raw_scope (INV-1).
D-7/OD-6 break-glass, 15-min default read-only, loud (oversight+audit+after-action), no second approval needed at 900s.
D-7/OD-6 break-glass at 3600s (>900) WITH the required second human approval (if/then satisfied).
D-8 aggregate roll-up request: scope_kind const aggregate, small_cell_floor 5, no raw fields expressible.
D-8 de-identified result: counted cells all >= k=5 plus a suppressed small cell; no objectRef/raw record anywhere.
D-6 outbound submission to A05: distinct external auth (mTLS+signed+replay), minimized record, residency deny-by-default — external peer kept separated (INV-2/OD-3/OD-5).
D-6 inbound directive: auto_execute const false, lands in a review queue — never auto-executes (INV-2).
D-5 parent (tier) edge: governance only, confers_raw_read false (INV-1).
D-5 escalation (down->up): a single digest-bound object shared upward with its marking.
D-5 tasking (up->down): authority-to-direct, confers_raw_read false (INV-1).
D-1 governed archive with same-tenant backfill (reorg-churn AC-11) — no hard-delete, terminal state archived.
D-1 governed suspend transition (active->suspended).

examples.invariant: TIER IS DATA (D-1): tier is a tierOrdinal integer; a hard-coded administrative NAME ('province' as a string) is not expressible — no fixed tier names ship in the schema.

INV-2: an external (A05) node has no governance parent — the if(boundary_kind=external)-then(parent_id=null) rule rejects a non-null parent_id; an external peer is never a child/ancestor of internal nodes.
INV-2/OD-1: node_boundary_kind is const 'internal' — an external (A05) peer is NEVER an org_node member; an 'external' membership is structurally impossible.
INV-2 EXTERNAL-AS-ANCESTOR: a 'parent' edge's from_node.boundary_kind must be const 'internal' — an external authority can never be an ancestor of an internal node.

INV-1 ANCESTOR RAW ESCALATION: subject_relationship 'ancestor-governance' forbids raw_scope (raw_scope:false) and forces scope_kind aggregate — an ancestor's cross-tier reach can never carry automatic raw.
FAIL-CLOSED: a descendant raw grant's raw_scope.patterns is minItems 1 — an empty scope array denies (it is not grant-all); an empty-scope 'assigned-row' fail-open is rejected.
OD-2 SMALL CELL: an unsuppressed cell count is minimum 5 (the k=5 floor); a count of 3 is a re-identification risk and cannot be reported unsuppressed — it must be a suppressed cell.
NO RAW IN AGGREGATE (D-8): additionalProperties:false on a cell rejects an 'object_refs' raw drill-down handle — an aggregate never carries a raw record/objectRef.

OD-3 EXTERNAL INTERNAL-TOKEN: the authorization is additionalProperties:false with auth_context const 'external-distinct' — an internal_service_token/bearer has nowhere to live; no internal credential is reused across the external boundary.
NO HARD-DELETE (D-1): operation enum is suspend|reactivate|archive|restore — a 'delete' of a referenced node is not expressible; a referenced node is archived, never row-deleted.

OD-1 CROSS-TENANT EDGE: from_node.tenant_binding ('tenant-acme') != to_node.tenant_binding ('tenant-globex'). Structurally valid; the relying party MUST reject a cross-tenant hierarchy edge (a schema cannot compare two field values). Hierarchy never weakens tenant isolation (FC-2).
ACYCLICITY: from_node == to_node ('on-region' self-loop). Structurally valid; the relying party MUST reject an edge whose endpoints form a cycle (a schema cannot walk the graph). Tree, not DAG (D-1).

SIBLING ACCESS: a structurally valid 'explicit-descendant-grant' whose target ('on-commune-b') is a SIBLING of the subject's node, not a descendant. The relying party MUST verify the subject's tree relationship to target_node matches subject_relationship (a schema cannot walk the tree); a sibling/unrelated node is not a valid descendant target (INV-1).

MARKING DOWNGRADE (AC-9): marking (public/TLP:CLEAR) is below origin_marking ('restricted;TLP:RED'). Structurally valid; the relying party MUST reject a marking downgraded relative to the source before a crossing (marking is never downgraded; a schema cannot compare a marking to its provenance) (FC-6).

EXPIRY (FC-7): temporal.expires_at (2030-03-01) is before the test clock NOW (2030-03-13). Structurally valid; the relying party MUST NOT re-authorize an expired grant on idempotent replay (a schema cannot compare against wall-clock time).

REVOCATION (FC-7): temporal.revoked is true within the validity window. Structurally valid; the relying party MUST treat a revoked grant as authorizing nothing (a schema cannot enforce immediate revocation state).
